answer: The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in basalt, expire in summit, and zenith lists each expiry. Someone running 18 aliases therefore needs 188 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2461 identities would post 4909 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
